tasks: all 18; full frozen legal candidate pools, no pair-only expert
initialization: identical prepared fresh R77 seed2 parameters and TRAIN geometry statistics; no trained selector checkpoint
model: original R77 instance/method dual streams, shared score MLP, score differences and maximin
role_problem: TSP only; the other 17 tasks preserve their original input attributes and model path
role_feature_layout: pad original TSP xy to the existing eight node channels; fill only previously-zero channel3, indexed from0

A_canonical_anchor.marker: input-only lexicographic minimum x then y among valid nodes
A_canonical_anchor.exact_coordinate_ties: mark every node tied at the canonical coordinate; no row-index tie break
A_canonical_anchor.interpretation: recoverable geometric anchor control, not the deployed solver start

B_execution_anchor.marker: actual original physical node0 used by the locked single-start BQ and LEHD deployments
B_execution_anchor.multiplicity: exactly one valid physical node; BQ's internal duplicate endpoint is not added to selector inputs
B_execution_anchor.interpretation: explicit existing deployment role, not a depot or arbitrary full positional embedding

role_API: explicit prepared role markers move with their physical nodes under pure reindexing; only unmarked raw inputs derive the arm's anchor
input_isolation: no current cost, winner, route or oracle in model forward; do not mutate the source batch
unchanged_physical_inputs: coordinates, distances, native constraints, _coord_stats and cached physical geometry remain unchanged by the marker
objective: unchanged R77: 0.35 native CE + 0.35 within-instance comparison + 0.02 relative-gap risk + original ramped R-Drop
optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=1e-4; cosine successful-update schedule to1e-6
execution: one already allocated gpu03 3090 per arm, predecessor full TEST/LIB/PDF rc0 required; no new allocation or preemption
batch_and_task_order: same deterministic natural R84/R77 full18 order, same logical batches
checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct using TRAIN-fitted SBS; first exact tie retained
formal_evaluation: unique checkpoint and fixed role rule selected with VAL only, then complete same-version TEST and both LIBs
empirical_screen: B increases VAL macro Top1 while macro mean_cost and actual regret do not increase against both matched A and historical same-data R84A
mechanism_metrics: all18 and per-task TRAIN/VAL/TEST selection, fixed R84 target recall/rescues/lost/false picks, paired cost changes; TSP-specific effect must not be generalized to all tasks
prior_source_evidence: Sol's bounded trace found no execution marker in current selector inputs and generation-profile/source-hash evidence for BQ/LEHD single physical-node0 starts; no route reruns or error-budget attribution
evidence_boundary: role omission is confirmed in the stated input/deployment records, not proven to explain the overall Top1 platform; this is an input-representation test, not solver or label repair
